(deftype TransientHashMap [^:mutable ^boolean edit
                           ^:mutable root
                           ^:mutable count
                           ^:mutable ^boolean has_nil_QMARK_
                           ^:mutable nil_val]
  Object
  (conj_BANG_ [tcoll o]
    (if edit
      (cond
        (map-entry? o)
        (.assoc_BANG_ tcoll (key o) (val o))

        (vector? o)
        (.assoc_BANG_ tcoll (o 0) (o 1))

        :else
        (loop [es (seq o) tcoll tcoll]
          (let [hamt-bootstrap-iflet-9 (first es)] (if hamt-bootstrap-iflet-9 (let [e hamt-bootstrap-iflet-9] (recur (next es)
                   (.assoc_BANG_ tcoll (key e) (val e)))) tcoll))))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "conj! after persistent"))))

  (assoc_BANG_ [tcoll k v]
    (if edit
      (if (nil? k)
        (do (if (identical? nil_val v)
              nil
              (set! nil_val v))
            (if has_nil_QMARK_
              nil
              (do (set! count (inc count))
                  (set! has_nil_QMARK_ true)))
            tcoll)
        (let [added-leaf? (Box. false)
              node        (-> (if (nil? root)
                                (.-EMPTY BitmapIndexedNode)
                                root)
                              (.inode_assoc_BANG_ edit 0 (hash k) k v added-leaf?))]
          (if (identical? node root)
            nil
            (set! root node))
          ;; FIXME: can we figure out something better here?
          (if ^boolean (.-val added-leaf?)
            (set! count (inc count)))
          tcoll))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "assoc! after persistent!"))))

  (without_BANG_ [tcoll k]
    (if edit
      (if (nil? k)
        (if has_nil_QMARK_
          (do (set! has_nil_QMARK_ false)
              (set! nil_val nil)
              (set! count (dec count))
              tcoll)
          tcoll)
        (if (nil? root)
          tcoll
          (let [removed-leaf? (Box. false)
                node (.inode_without_BANG_ root edit 0 (hash k) k removed-leaf?)]
            (if (identical? node root)
              nil
              (set! root node))
            ;; FIXME: can we figure out something better here?
            (if ^boolean (.-val removed-leaf?)
              (set! count (dec count)))
            tcoll)))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "dissoc! after persistent!"))))

  (persistent_BANG_ [tcoll]
    (if edit
      (do (set! edit nil)
          (PersistentHashMap. nil count root has_nil_QMARK_ nil_val nil))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "persistent! called twice"))))

  ICounted
  (-count [coll]
    (if edit
      count
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "count after persistent!"))))

  ILookup
  (-lookup [tcoll k]
    (if (nil? k)
      (if has_nil_QMARK_
        nil_val)
      (if (nil? root)
        nil
        (.inode_lookup root 0 (hash k) k))))

  (-lookup [tcoll k not-found]
    (if (nil? k)
      (if has_nil_QMARK_
        nil_val
        not-found)
      (if (nil? root)
        not-found
        (.inode_lookup root 0 (hash k) k not-found))))

  ITransientCollection
  (-conj! [tcoll val] (.conj_BANG_ tcoll val))

  (-persistent! [tcoll] (.persistent_BANG_ tcoll))

  ITransientAssociative
  (-assoc! [tcoll key val] (.assoc_BANG_ tcoll key val))

  ITransientMap
  (-dissoc! [tcoll key] (.without_BANG_ tcoll key))

  IFn
  (-invoke [tcoll key]
    (-lookup tcoll key))
  (-invoke [tcoll key not-found]
    (-lookup tcoll key not-found)))
